projects.name: AlohaMini2
projects.summary: Open-source dual-arm mobile manipulator with a motorized lift, five cameras, printable hardware, LeRobot integration, and an official sourcing BOM under $1,100.
projects.description: AlohaMini2 is the reinforced generation of the AlohaMini embodied-AI platform. It combines a printable omnidirectional mobile base, dual 6+1 DoF AM-ARM200 follower arms, a 30 kg lift, Raspberry Pi 5 compute, five cameras, and openly published CAD, assembly, printing, and sourcing documentation.
